name: traceframe-workspace
description: Turn raw logs into an interactive incident timeline.

scripts.build: pnpm --filter @traceframe/parser-sdk build && pnpm --filter @traceframe/parsers build && pnpm --filter @traceframe/core build && pnpm --filter @traceframe/exporters build && pnpm --filter @traceframe/web build && pnpm --filter traceframe build
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @traceframe/parser-sdk build && pnpm --filter @traceframe/parsers build && vitest run
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @traceframe/parser-sdk build && pnpm --filter @traceframe/parsers build && pnpm --filter @traceframe/core build && pnpm --filter @traceframe/exporters build && pnpm --filter @traceframe/web typecheck && pnpm --filter traceframe typecheck
